title: Weighted sampled NDCG/MRR telemetry ingest for customer prompt diversity
creator: Anjali Rao
description:
Background: Our reranking telemetry currently over-represents heavy traffic customers and skews offline NDCG/MRR computation. This makes calibrations and A/B comparisons noisy for low-volume but high-sensitivity customers. We need a lightweight ingest layer that performs weighted, stratified sampling at the edge, preserves minimal provenance for A/B and rollout hooks, and enforces backpressure when the rerank endpoint is overloaded.

Goal: Implement a production-ready telemetry ingest that: 1) samples requests per-customer and per-prompt-template using configurable weights, 2) attaches experiment and model-variant tags to each sampled event for A/B analysis, 3) streams compact payloads (embedding ids, candidate scores, chosen rank, labels where available) to the eval pipeline with <200ms additional latency on p50 and controlled tail, 4) provides observability and provenance so offline NDCG/MRR metrics can be computed deterministically and rehydrated for replay.

Non-goals: This ticket does not implement the offline NDCG/MRR calculators or the frontend dashboard UI; those are separate follow-ups. The focus is on sampling, tagging, and safe ingestion/backpressure integration with existing Kafka topics and the rerank endpoint runtime.
acceptance_criteria: Edge sampling library integrated into rerank endpoint runtime and togglable via feature-flag
Sampling supports per-customer weights and per-prompt-template strata with fallback defaults
Sampled payload size limited to 1KB compressed and includes model_variant, experiment_id, candidate_ids, scores, chosen_index, timestamp, and optional ground_truth_id
End-to-end latency impact measured: additional p50 < 150ms, p95 < 400ms for sampled requests (on perf baseline)
Backpressure path: when ingest queue > 90% capacity, sampling rate halves and events are annotated with drop_reason, with zero request failures
Telemetry consumer team confirms payload schema and downstream Kafka topic (topic: eval.rerank.sampled.v2) and agrees on retention policy
Unit and integration tests cover sampling logic, weight fallbacks, and experiment tagging
Documentation: feature-flag rollout runbook and sampling configuration docs checked into Confluence
tasks: Design sampling config proto and default weight table (eng + PM review)
Implement sampling library in rerank runtime (Go) with reservoir-style per-customer sampler
Add experiment/model tagging hooks to the request context and ensure propagation into sampled payload
Compact serializer: JSON+zlib pipeline with schema versioning header
Integrate backpressure signals from ingest-sync queue and implement graceful degrade behavior
Add end-to-end integration tests: load test harness that validates latency and sample rates under burst
Add telemetry dashboard: sample rate by customer, ingestion queue utilization, dropped events per reason
Write rollout runbook and enable behind feature flag for 10% of traffic, increasing to 100% after verification
metrics: sampled events per customer per hour
replay completeness percentage for target prompt-templates
A/B delta confidence and standard error for ndcg/mrr metrics
rollout_plan: Feature-flag gated rollout: dev -> staging (smoke) -> canary (10% traffic over 48h) -> ramp (30%, 60%) -> 100%
During canary: monitor p95 latency, sample rate per-customer, and drop_rate. Abort if p95 increases > 25% or drop_rate > 1% for >15m
Run a controlled A/B replay after 30k sampled events to validate NDCG/MRR stability versus baseline
Post-rollout: run nightly backfills for customers with sparse sampling to improve retrospective evals
